title: Rahdar plugin.json
description: The descriptor every plugin jar carries at META-INF/rahdar/plugin.json (ADR-0099, ADR-0102). This schema is documentation for plugin authors; PluginDescriptorParser is the code path that actually enforces it, and a test asserts the two never drift apart.

id.description: vendor-name, at least two kebab-case segments, at most 50 characters, never identity-*.

contract.description: Must equal the extension contract this build compiled against.

requiresLicense.description: The plugin needs a license file: admins upload one in Admin > Plugins, the plugin reads it and reports whether it is valid.

scope.description: Where the permission takes effect. global: checked without a cluster, only a global grant makes it take effect. cluster: checked against a cluster, a global, environment or cluster grant makes it take effect. resource: checked against a subscription or destination of a cluster; a platform grant, a team role or a share makes it take effect.

resourceTypes.description: What a resource permission acts on. Required, and not empty, when scope is resource; refused for any other scope.

requires.description: Permissions a role must hold with this one, from the plugin or from Rahdar (for example subscription:read). The role editor adds them, and saving a role without them is refused.

subject.description: What the values are keyed by, e.g. job.

permission.description: A declared permission that reads the series.

key.description: Stable per plugin; a rule is seeded once per key and cluster.

identityProviders.description: Username-and-password sign-ins the plugin offers; each needs a PluginCredentialProvider bean. Needs a trusted signer and an acknowledgement at install.

approvalProvider.description: The plugin is the approval provider: it exposes one ApprovalProvider bean and Rahdar asks it whether gated operations may run. At most one active plugin may declare it.

approverPermission.description: A permission the plugin declares under permissions; the users who approve hold it.

audit.description: Access to the audit log. receive: the plugin is handed every audit event, unfiltered. retentionHold: the plugin may hold audit records back from retention. Each needs an acknowledgement at install.

posture.description: read: the tool changes nothing and is annotated readOnlyHint = true.

scope.description: Matches the scope of the permission. resource: Rahdar checks the permission on the subscription or destination named by the tool's resourceArg, on the cluster named by its required clusterId argument. cluster: on that cluster. global: globally.

permission.description: One of this plugin's permissions; Rahdar checks it before the tool runs.

resourceArg.description: Required for scope resource, refused otherwise: the tool's required string argument holding the subscription or destination name.

resourceType.description: Required for scope resource, refused otherwise: what resourceArg names. The permission's resourceTypes must include it.
